violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution between uses.

Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. -2 door prep cooler at 55F. Door seal has a tear which is losing cold air. Must try to keep prep cooler top closed on hot days except as needed.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Food contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in good repair or sound condition. -Door seal on prep cooler needs replaced. It is torn.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Floors need further cleaning.
Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution between uses. -2 sitting on counter.
General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. -Door seal torn on 2 door prep cooler.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Clean inside 2 door prep cooler.
Manual cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --No sanitizer on trailer.
